text: Ah, s’blood, how you have hurt me! My shoulder quite burns.” “If you would permit me—” said D’Artagnan, with timidity. “What, monsieur?” “I have a miraculous balsam for wounds—a balsam given to me by my mother and of which I have made a trial upon myself.” “Well?” “Well, I am sure that in less than three days this balsam would cure you; and at the end of three days, when you would be cured—well, sir, it would still do me a great honor to be your man.” D’Artagnan spoke these words with a simplicity that did honor to his courtesy, without throwing the least doubt upon his courage. “Pardieu, monsieur!” said Athos, “that’s a proposition that pleases me; not that I can accept it, but a league off it savors of the gentleman. Thus spoke and acted the gallant knights of the time of Charlemagne, in whom every cavalier ought to seek his model.
